decisions: Disposition stays in ability_spec.py with the other three closed vocabularies, and quantity.py reads it from there. Moving it is what the check proposed, and the tests refuse it: TestClosedVocabularies pins the residue as a dependency-free leaf three ways (no module-scope sibling import, no deferred one, and the file executes with no package around it), and the chain that reaches Disposition from the contract is DamagePart's quoted 'ZeroPolicy | None' annotation, so ZeroPolicy and Disposition both have to stay for the residue to import nothing. quantity.py is the algebra over the tag, not the tag.

extract_modules.py refused that direction before this assignment: any read of a residue unit was a back-edge, whether or not the residue read back. It now spells the read as an import of the source and refuses a cycle instead, the residue counted as one node of the graph (tests/test_extract_modules.py::TestPlanning::test_a_read_of_a_unit_that_stays_is_imported_from_the_source and TestRefusals::test_a_cycle_through_the_residue_refuses).
ControlEvent references no name in A1: control_spec.py checks as a leaf with no dependency on quantity.py or the residue, confirming the map's open question.
control_spec.py is an internal-import-free leaf and quantity.py reads one module, so neither can fire the fan-out arm however many readers repoint.
